claim_being_audited: That the model can be certified for launch on the current record, based on aggregate readiness and governance controls, despite the unresolved emergency-shelter segment weakness.
decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence shows certification satisfies the disclosure policy threshold.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment, protected segment, or named launch use case.
Product labels such as non-core or low-volume do not resolve materiality when the segment is named in customer commitments or legal review is pending.
Certification becomes supportable if the material limitation is disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Without that support link, aggregate readiness evidence alone is insufficient for a clean compliance finding.
evidence_requests: Final legal determination on whether the emergency shelter placement gap must be disclosed before launch.
Approved risk-acceptance record, if one exists, covering this named launch use case.
Final model-card or launch disclosure text showing the emergency shelter placement limitation is explicitly disclosed.
Any contractual or launch-governance document defining whether the two nonprofit commitments make this segment a named launch use case for certification purposes.
specific_concerns: The named emergency shelter placement segment misses target by 1.5 percentage points, which is evidence of a material limitation for a named launch use case.
Policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required is still open, so the disclosure predicate is unresolved.
There is no admissible evidence of an approved risk acceptance or a finalized disclosure decision.
Aggregate pass status and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not resolve the separate policy requirement for disclosure of a material weakness.
Product's 'non-core' framing is weakened by the evidence that the segment is named in two nonprofit deployment commitments.
unsupported_claims: The recommendation to certify is not fully supported unless certification explicitly includes the required weakness disclosure or an approved risk acceptance.
Any implication that the weakness can be treated as non-material based on low projected traffic is unsupported under the stated policy.
Any omission of weakness disclosure would be unsupported on the current record.
